articles.headline: Karnataka plans new road grid system and infrastructure projects in Bengaluru
articles.title: Karnataka Chief Minister: State govt. plans to establish new road grid system for Bengaluru
articles.summary: The Karnataka government is developing a new road grid system and clearing stormwater drain encroachments in Bengaluru to address urban planning shortcomings. Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced the initiative during a foundation stone laying ceremony for a ₹2,000 crore flood-mitigation project funded by the World Bank. The administration is also rerouting a planned Hosakote-Nandagudi road to 45 metres to preserve thousands of buildings and reduce government compensation burdens, alongside nearly ₹20,000 crore in ongoing infrastructure works.

articles.headline: Iraqi Prime Minister visits Lebanon to discuss alternative oil export routes
articles.title: Iraqi PM heads to Lebanon amid push to explore oil routes beyond Hormuz
articles.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi visited Beirut for high-level meetings with Lebanese leaders, including President Joseph Aoun, to discuss strengthening bilateral trade and security coordination. A primary focus of the talks involved diversifying Iraq's crude oil export routes by potentially reviving a defunct pipeline linking Kirkuk to Tripoli in northern Lebanon, thereby bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. The proposed infrastructure project could provide vital annual revenues to Lebanon amid its ongoing economic crisis.
articles.description: Ali al-Zaidi's talks expected to include proposed project linking Tripoli in Lebanon to Kirkuk-Baniyas pipeline.

articles.headline: Regional Meteorological Centre forecasts moderate rainfall for Chennai amid Cyclone Akvan
articles.title: Cyclone Akvan: RMC forecasts moderate rainfall for Chennai on Wednesday
articles.summary: The Regional Meteorological Centre in Chennai forecasted moderate rainfall at isolated places in Chennai, Tiruvallur, and Chengalpattu districts on Wednesday due to Cyclone Akvan. The cyclone was located about 610 kilometres east of Chennai at 8.30 a.m. on Tuesday and is expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm. According to forecasters, the system will likely cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Tuni on Thursday with maximum sustained winds of 120 to 130 kmph.
articles.description: The RMC has forecast moderate rainfall at isolated places in Chennai, Tiruvallur and Chengalpattu districts on Wednesday

articles.headline: R Vaishali uses tournament matches to prepare for world championship
articles.title: Hard grind a preparation for the World title match: Vaishali
articles.summary: Grandmaster R Vaishali is utilizing the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot in Budapest as preparation for her upcoming world title match against reigning champion Ju Wenjun of China. Vaishali secured her challenger position by winning the Women's Candidates in Cyprus in April. During Sunday's matches, she defeated Arjun Erigaisi with the white pieces in their second Fast Classic game after capitalizing on a late error by her opponent.

articles.headline: Russian missile strikes damage bridges and disrupt transport in Kyiv
articles.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
articles.summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck the Pivnichnyi and Pivdennyi bridges in Kyiv late Monday, causing significant damage and large craters that forced closures and widespread travel disruptions. Recovery operations are under way as residents navigate the aftermath of the bombardment. The attacks coincided with Ukrainian missile strikes that severely damaged the bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea, marking a tense night of infrastructure attacks between the warring nations.
articles.description: Moscow has targeted bridges in Kyiv, while Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea.

articles.headline: NMDC plans to expand iron ore pellet production capacity
articles.title: NMDC eyes 24 million tonnes pellet capacity
articles.summary: NMDC, formerly the National Mineral Development Corporation, aims to reach 24 million tonnes of annual pellet production capacity. Chairman Amitava Mukherjee announced the expansion on November 15, noting that the company is integrating iron ore-to-pellet infrastructure. The firm is also diversifying into coal production in Jharkhand and enhancing logistics to support its long-term growth strategy.

articles.headline: Sai Parenterals acquires majority stake in Bion Therapeutics India
articles.title: Sai Parenterals acquiring majority stake in Bion
articles.summary: Sai Parenterals is acquiring a majority stake in the Hyderabad-based firm Bion Therapeutics India through its subsidiary, SP Analytics. The all-cash deal, expected to close this month, adds 16 brands and 250 staff to the company. Sai Parenterals plans to shift Bion's production to its own accredited facilities to improve quality and supply chain control.
articles.description: The acquisition will add 16 established brands and around 250 field staff, strengthening its presence in India’s prescription market, Sai Parenterals said.

articles.headline: CAIR condemns potential terrorist designation and defends civil rights work
articles.title: CAIR defends civil rights work against Trump’s ‘smear’
articles.summary: The Council on American-Islamic Relations condemned statements by United States President Donald Trump regarding a possible blanket terrorist designation against the Muslim civil liberties organisation. In a statement issued on Tuesday, CAIR asserted that the administration should focus on addressing a surge in violent hate crimes against American Muslims rather than targeting free speech and civil rights advocacy. Trump had previously told reporters outside the White House that his administration was monitoring the organisation and that a designation could happen.
articles.description: The US's largest Muslim advocacy group urges President Trump to address rising hate crimes against Muslims.

articles.headline: Congress accuses Union government of economic mismanagement amid rising household and industry inflation
articles.title: Rising prices reflect government’s economic mismanagement: Congress
articles.summary: The Congress party alleged on November 17, 2026, that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's economic policies caused severe inflation and distress for households and businesses. Citing a recent survey, party official Jairam Ramesh stated that monthly expenditures rose over twenty percent for many families, while high input costs and tariffs forced numerous garment factories to close.
articles.description: Monthly costs up by over 20% for 61% of families, according to a survey cited by Congress leader Jairam Ramesh; claims PM is more pre-occupied with politics than tackling the inflation crisis

articles.headline: Thousands protest upcoming Oxford University talk by Nathan Cofnas
articles.title: Thousands demand cancellation of Nathan Cofnas talk at Oxford University
articles.summary: Thousands of individuals signed a petition demanding the cancellation of an event featuring American academic Nathan Cofnas at Oxford University's Oriel College. Organized by the Oxford Reform student society, the Tuesday evening lecture focuses on diversity in higher education. Cofnas previously faced dismissal and suspension following plagiarism allegations and controversial statements linking race to intelligence, prompting widespread student protests and university statements regarding event hosting.
articles.description: Online petition with more than 32,000 signatures demands the university 'cancel Nathan Cofnas's invitation to speak'.

articles.headline: Wipro 3D partners with Markforged for industrial printing in India
articles.title: Wipro 3D ties up with Markforged to expand industrial 3D printing in India
articles.summary: Additive manufacturing firm Wipro 3D formed a strategic partnership with industrial printing provider Markforged to expand composite three-dimensional printing access across India. Combining engineering expertise with continuous fiber reinforcement technology, the collaboration aims to help manufacturers in aerospace, defence, and automotive sectors produce lightweight components and reduce production lead times.
articles.description: The collaboration will also focus on developing in-house composite additive manufacturing capabilities among Indian manufacturers.

articles.headline: Student-led movement takes seats in Serbia's new parliament
articles.title: Election-winning student movement enters Serbia’s new parliament
articles.summary: The Serbian parliament convened in Belgrade on Tuesday following an October 25 election that saw the grassroots Student List movement secure 140 of 250 seats. This shift ends the dominance of President Aleksandar Vucic and the Serbian Progressive Party. Lawmakers now face a 90-day constitutional deadline to form a new government or trigger snap elections.
articles.description: Hundreds hail Student List lawmakers as the new parliament meets for the first time.

articles.headline: Manu Bhaker joins International Shooting Sport Federation Athletes Committee
articles.title: Manu Bhaker elected to ISSF Athletes Committee for 2026-30 term
articles.summary: Double Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker has secured a position on the International Shooting Sport Federation Athletes Committee for the term spanning from 2026 to 2030. She aims to prioritize sustainable environments for shooters and better prize money. Former Olympic champion Abhinav Bindra previously served on this committee between 2010 and 2020.
articles.description: During her nomination earlier this month, Bhaker had outlined an athlete-centric vision, focusing on strengthening the sport and creating a more supportive, sustainable and progressive environment for shooters worldwide

articles.headline: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
articles.title: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
articles.description: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford spoke to residents near the site of the overnight strike.

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: Deadly settler pogroms persist
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Deadly settler pogroms persist
articles.description: A Palestinian woman was killed in a settler shooting near Jericho, while Arab MPs in Israel seek Netanyahu probe.

articles.headline: Moily claims Congress leaders stalled Modi investigation
articles.title: Some Congress leaders stalled probe into Modi in Gujarat riots case, claims Veerappa Moily
articles.summary: Former Union Minister M. Veerappa Moily alleged that unidentified leaders within the United Progressive Alliance government obstructed an investigation into Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the 2002 Gujarat riots. Speaking at a book launch in Bengaluru on November 17, 2026, Moily claimed the inquiry was halted despite Supreme Court directives. He also stated that internal resistance prevented organizational reforms proposed by party chairperson Sonia Gandhi.

articles.headline: Opposition questions Supreme Court decision to grant bail to Bilkis Bano convicts
articles.title: Opposition questions Supreme Court order in Bilkis Bano case
articles.summary: Opposition leaders criticized a Supreme Court bench comprising Justices M.M. Sundresh and P.B. Varale for granting bail to two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case on November 17, 2026. The Congress and CPI(M) condemned the order, stating the survivor endured fresh trauma without prior notice, while the court cited their seventeen years in prison.
articles.description: Congress says Bilkis is being put through ‘fresh humiliation and trauma’, while CPI(M) calls SC order ‘shocking and reprehensible’

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu launches HPV-DNA testing programme in five districts for cervical cancer
articles.title: HPV-DNA testing to be implemented in five high-burden districts of T.N.
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu will implement HPV-DNA testing for cervical cancer across Dharmapuri, Villupuram, Tiruvannamalai, Perambalur, and Ariyalur districts, covering 124,215 women in the first phase. Supported by central approval and funds of 869.50 lakh rupees under the National Health Mission, the initiative aims to strengthen primary screening and address high morbidity rates among women.
articles.description: Dharmapuri, Villupuram, Tiruvannamalai, Perambalur and Ariyalur will be covered in the first phase

articles.headline: Skilled worker shortage increases cyclone repair costs across coastal Andhra Pradesh districts
articles.title: Skilled-worker shortage pushes up cyclone repair costs in coastal Andhra
articles.summary: Residents in Eluru, West Godavari, and Krishna districts faced severe financial losses and high repair costs following Cyclones Arnab and Murasu. A shortage of skilled workers like masons and electricians drove daily wages up significantly, leaving many households struggling with damaged roofs and submerged water motors without full normalcy restored.
articles.description: Residents face repair bills ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh as a shortage of technicians pushes up wages and delays restoration of damaged houses in Eluru, West Godavari and Krishna districts

articles.headline: Bangladesh adviser states India cannot dictate terms regarding Sheikh Hasina return
articles.title: India cannot dictate terms on Hasina’s return to Bangladesh: PM’s adviser
articles.summary: Bangladesh information adviser Zahed Ur Rahman stated on November 17, 2026, that India cannot dictate conditions for the return of deposed Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. While media reports suggested New Delhi sought judicial safeguards and direct army reception, Dhaka insisted any extradition and subsequent legal procedures will follow domestic laws strictly.
articles.description: Hasina has been staying in India since fleeing the country in August 2024 following a student-led uprising that toppled her government

articles.headline: Uttar Pradesh publishes draft electoral roll with 13.58 crore voters ahead of 2027 elections
articles.title: 13.58 crore voters in U.P. draft electoral roll; 18 lakh added since SIR
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh election office published a draft electoral roll containing 13.58 crore voters on November 17, 2026, marking an increase of 18 lakh since April. Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa reported the figures during a Lucknow press conference, noting the list excludes religion-based data. The revision precedes the 2027 Assembly election, with claims and objections accepted until December 16.
articles.description: Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa says Election Commission does not keep religion-wise data on voters; Akhilesh questions CM Yogi’s recent claim that 1.27 crore Hindu voters were removed

articles.headline: Southern Transitional Council gains prominence as Houthi forces advance toward Aden
articles.title: Houthi advance on Aden may spur resurgence of Yemen’s southern separatists
articles.summary: An advancing Houthi military threat toward Aden has elevated the importance of the Southern Transitional Council, a southern Yemeni secessionist movement supported by the United Arab Emirates. Following recent government force withdrawals, STC leaders are mobilizing defenses. Analysts warn the group remains politically divided and reliant on Saudi backing to effectively repel the ongoing offensive.
articles.description: Southern separatists try to regain power to defend Aden as Saudi Arabia reshuffles its military command against Houthis.

articles.headline: Mozambique opposition leader Venancio Mondlane faces trial over election unrest
articles.title: Mozambique opposition leader goes on trial for terrorism over deadly election protests
articles.summary: Prominent Mozambican opposition leader Venancio Mondlane appeared in the Supreme Court in Maputo to face trial on charges including incitement to terrorism and civil disobedience. The proceedings follow deadly post-election protests stemming from disputed presidential results in 2024 that declared Daniel Chapo the winner. Rights groups reported over three hundred deaths during the subsequent unrest, while police recorded ninety-six fatalities.
articles.description: Venâncio Mondlane faces several charges over 2024 post-election protests that left hundreds of people dead.

articles.headline: Karnataka to move Supreme Court over rural development grants
articles.title: Karnataka to move Supreme Court over ₹2,186 crore rural development grants: Eshwar Khandre
articles.summary: The Karnataka government announced it will approach the Supreme Court within a week to seek the release of two thousand one hundred eighty-six crore rupees in grants under the fifteenth Finance Commission. Rural Development Minister Eshwar B. Khandre stated that technical portal discrepancies caused the Union government to withhold funds, while Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar prepares to launch new rural infrastructure schemes.

articles.headline: Democratic senators urge Federal Aviation Administration to pause router replacements following national ground stop
articles.title: US senators demand FAA pause upgrades linked to nationwide ground stop
articles.summary: Thirteen Democratic senators urged the Federal Aviation Administration to halt upcoming router replacements following an investigation into a nationwide ground stop on Friday that canceled over 10,000 flights. The FAA attributed the disruption to network upgrades involving L3Harris and Juniper Networks equipment. Meanwhile, the FBI and Department of Transportation are investigating the technical failure.
articles.description: Thousands of routers used in communications systems are slated to be replaced, raising the risk of more problems.

articles.headline: BJP criticises Telangana government over Bharat Summit expenditure
articles.title: BJP slams govt. over Bharat Summit spending, unmet promises
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party Legislature Party leader A. Maheshwar Reddy accused the Telangana government of misusing nearly one hundred crore rupees of public funds on the Bharat Summit instead of aiding drought-affected farmers. He also demanded an apology for controversial remarks made by an Italian politician at the event, while party spokesperson N.V. Subhash criticised the administration over unfulfilled election promises.

articles.headline: P.K. Mishra highlights coordination and citizen experience in governance
articles.title: Modi’s governance journey marked by coordination across govt departments, focus on citizen experience: P.K. Mishra
articles.summary: Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister P.K. Mishra emphasised the importance of seamless department coordination and citizen experience during an event organised by Niti Aayog in New Delhi. Marking twenty-five years of Narendra Modi as head of government, officials discussed milestones including disaster responses and the Lakhpati Didi initiative, aiming towards a developed nation by twenty forty-seven.
articles.description: The principal secretary to the Prime Minister said India’s governance journey has been marked by defining milestones that demonstrate the power of decisive leadership and the ability to translate vision into action

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh ranks fourth nationally in rooftop solar installations
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh ranks fourth in installation of rooftop solar systems nationally
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh secured fourth place in India for implementing the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, with 7,39,260 households equipped with rooftop solar systems as of November 15, 2026. Special Chief Secretary for Energy K. Vijayanand directed officials to upload installation data by December 15, 2026, warning that missing data would disqualify beneficiaries from receiving government subsidies.
articles.description: The State accounts for nearly 13% of the 56.97 lakh households covered across the country, behind Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat and Maharashtra

articles.headline: Karnataka chief minister D.K. Shivakumar outlines tech expansion goals
articles.title: Karnataka charting next tech leap to push AI, deep-tech: CM D.K. Shivakumar
articles.summary: Karnataka aims to become a global hub for artificial intelligence and semiconductor manufacturing, according to Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on November 17, 2026. Speaking in Bengaluru, he noted the State attracted $9.4 billion in foreign direct investment equity during the first half of fiscal year 2025-26. The government plans new initiatives, including a government-driven artificial intelligence university and semiconductor facility investments exceeding ₹23,000 crore.
articles.description: Inaugurating the 29th Bengaluru Tech Summit, Shivakumar unveils major infrastructure, funding, and reskilling initiatives to lead global innovation beyond artificial intelligence

articles.headline: Om Birla urges women legislators to leverage AI for governance
articles.title: Women legislators must leverage AI for transparent, accountable governance: Om Birla
articles.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla inaugurated the Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians India Region Conference in Bengaluru, urging women representatives to utilise artificial intelligence for transparent governance. Leaders including Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara discussed the implementation of the Women Reservation Bill, digital safety, and mentorship pathways during the two-day event.

articles.headline: Prince William and Catherine honour young environmental winners in Mumbai
articles.title: Prince William, Catherine Honour Young Changemakers at First-Ever Children’s Earthshot Awards in Mumbai
articles.summary: Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, attended the inaugural Children’s Earthshot Awards in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. The event celebrated youth-led environmental projects across five categories, including climate and waste reduction. The initiative, which engaged nearly one million students, aims to foster local innovation to address urgent global environmental challenges and sustainability.
articles.description: Founded by Prince William and incubated in The Royal Foundation in 2020, the Earthshot Prize is the world’s most prestigious environmental award, designed to identify, back and celebrate groundbreaking leadership in environmental action

articles.headline: Documentary explores environmental impact of conflict in Afghanistan
articles.title: Ghost Towns of Afghanistan: The Environmental Toll of Decades of War
articles.summary: The documentary film Ghost Towns of Afghanistan, directed by Matty Feurtado and Ibrahim Sulemen Khel, examines the long-term environmental degradation caused by decades of war. The film follows Ibrahim, a Kabul resident, as he returns to his home in Nangarhar province to witness the ruins and health crises facing families living in contaminated conflict zones.
articles.description: A father confronts the aftermath of environmental damage from years of war in Afghanistan.

articles.headline: Mahendra Singh Dhoni retires from IPL playing career with Chennai Super Kings
articles.title: Dhoni ends IPL playing career as CSK appoints him team mentor
articles.summary: Mahendra Singh Dhoni announced his retirement from active Indian Premier League play on November 17, 2026, concluding a career that began in 2008. The Chennai Super Kings owner N. Srinivasan appointed Dhoni as the team mentor for the five-time champions ahead of the 2027 season, following a period marked by injuries and the team failing to reach the playoffs.
articles.description: The announcement comes ahead of the IPL 2027 retention deadline

articles.headline: Rep. Thomas Massie Forces a New Fight for Epstein Survivors
articles.title: Rep. Thomas Massie Forces a New Fight for Epstein Survivors
articles.description: Kentucky Republican Rep. Thomas Massie is pushing for justice for victims of the Epstein files.

articles.headline: India prepares for opening Test match against New Zealand
articles.title: IND vs NZ Tests: India faces test of character as WTC hopes hang in balance
articles.summary: India faces New Zealand in the opening Test match of a two-match series at the Basin Reserve in Wellington on November 17, 2026. The series carries significant implications for India's qualification hopes for the World Test Championship final and its quest for a first series victory in New Zealand in 17 years. Captain Shubman Gill indicated the team may select four pace-bowling options for the match.
articles.description: After winning the T20I and ODI series, India turn their attention to the Tests. With conditions favouring pace, Gill and the team management must balance bowling firepower with batting depth

articles.headline: Lakshya Raichandani dedicates under-19 Asia Cup victory to coach
articles.title: Lakshya dedicates u-19 Asia Cup win to his late coach
articles.summary: Opening batter Lakshya Raichandani has dedicated his under-19 Asia Cup triumph to his late coach, Abhishek Kumar, following a victory over Pakistan in the final. The 18-year-old cricketer from Uttar Pradesh scored 80 runs in the summit clash and reflected on his long-standing journey training in Uttarakhand since the age of ten.

articles.headline: Indian stock markets extend rally driven by foreign fund inflows
articles.title: Stock markets rally second day on foreign fund inflows, moderate crude oil prices
articles.summary: Benchmark stock indices extended their rally for the second consecutive day, with the BSE Sensex climbing 427.40 points to settle at 82,532.19 and the NSE Nifty reaching 25,387.40. This upward movement was supported by steady foreign fund inflows, moderate crude oil prices, and strong buying in Reliance Industries and major banking stocks despite weak global trends.
articles.description: The 30-share BSE Sensex rallied 427.40 points, or 0.52%, to settle at 82,532.19; during the day, it surged 792.7 points, or 0.96%, to 82,897.49.

articles.headline: French students continue protests over poor school conditions
articles.title: At the origin of France’s education protests, students refuse to give up
articles.summary: Students across France are maintaining blockades at schools to protest deteriorating infrastructure and lack of resources. The movement, which began in September, saw hundreds of thousands of participants in October. While the government promised to address concerns, students report no significant improvements. Teachers have joined the protests, citing systemic neglect and insufficient educational funding.
articles.description: Blockades continue at some schools in the Parisian suburbs as students and teachers say little has improved.

articles.headline: Why do governments switch off the internet?
articles.title: Why do governments switch off the internet?
articles.description: The internet went dark somewhere every day in 2025. AJLabs explains why authorities switch it off.

articles.headline: Telangana debt servicing reached 26.8% of total receipts in 2024-25
articles.title: Telangana’s debt servicing accounted to 26.8% of 2024-25 total receipts, says CESS study
articles.summary: According to a study by the Centre for Economic and Social Studies, debt servicing in Telangana accounted for 26.8% of total receipts during 2024-25, totaling ₹62,953 crore against receipts of ₹2.36 lakh crore. The report highlighted that outstanding total liabilities reached ₹5,61,787 crore, exceeding the state's GSDP ceiling limit. Meanwhile, the Congress government noted a subsequent decline in average borrowing costs.
articles.description: No information on maturity dates and interest pertaining to OBBs, says the report

articles.headline: Prime Minister Andy Burnham delays unveiling options for UK-EU ties
articles.title: Burnham delays tabling of options for U.K.-EU ties
articles.summary: United Kingdom Prime Minister Andy Burnham delayed presenting long-term options for ties between the United Kingdom and the European Union until the next Parliament. Speaking at the City Hall banquet, Burnham stated he would seek to finalize a closer relationship agreement at a summit on Friday while ruling out rejoining the European Union, accepting freedom of movement, or joining the single market.
articles.description: At Friday’s Summit Mr. Burnham said he seek to finalise an agreement with Brussels for closer U.K.-EU ties, based on the groundwork laid by his predecessor Keir Starmer

articles.headline: Delhi police arrest owner and contractor after Paharganj building collapse injures eight workers
articles.title: Delhi’s construction boom, workers’ growing risks: Safety takes a back seat as violations go unchecked
articles.summary: Delhi police arrested property owner Raman and contractor Anwar on November 16, 2026, following a building collapse in Kaseruwalan, Paharganj, that injured eight workers. According to the Municipal Corporation of Delhi, workers were removing shuttering from a newly constructed ground-floor lintel under a valid building plan when the structure gave way, though officials maintained active construction was not underway during air pollution restrictions.
articles.description: Missing helmets and protective gear, unsafe structures, punishing work hours and rushed construction expose a deepening safety crisis at Delhi’s building sites, where basic safeguards are routinely ignored and accountability often comes only after tragedy strikes

articles.headline: US Senate Democrats face internal contest for majority leadership
articles.title: How is US Senate majority leader chosen?
articles.summary: Following midterm elections, United States Senate Democrats face an internal leadership contest between incumbent Chuck Schumer and challenger Chris Van Hollen. Schumer has led the caucus since 2017 but faces criticism from progressive members regarding his strategy against Donald Trump's agenda, while Van Hollen launched his bid to present a fresh direction for the party.
articles.description: Chris Van Hollen set to challenge Chuck Schumer for the post as the Democrats prepare to take control of Congress.

articles.headline: Cyclone Akvan approaches Andhra Pradesh coast as IMD issues warning
articles.title: Cyclone Akvan to make landfall between Nellore and Tuni in Andhra as very severe storm on November 20
articles.summary: According to the India Meteorological Department, Cyclone Akvan is projected to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Nellore and Tuni as a very severe cyclonic storm by November 20 noon. Winds could reach 145 kmph. Officials have placed district administrations on high alert, suspended offshore operations, and instructed fishermen to remain ashore until November 20 due to dangerous conditions.
articles.description: Andhra fishermen, still awaiting compensation for Cyclone Arnab’s losses, are told to stay ashore till November 20

articles.headline: IN-SPACe selects three companies for urban settlement mapping
articles.title: Three space companies selected to develop high-resolution 3D reconstruction techniques for Indian cities
articles.summary: The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre has chosen three private entities under its Seed Fund Scheme to develop high-resolution human settlement layers for Indian cities. The chosen firms will receive seed funding of ₹1.46 crore to build satellite-based 3D reconstruction techniques, with initial pilot demonstrations scheduled to cover Bengaluru and Shimla.
articles.description: The pilot demonstrations will cover Bengaluru and Shimla, and the deliverables will include the horizontal and vertical dimensions of urban settlements, offering a more comprehensive understanding of how Indian cities are expanding and densifying.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh puts coastal districts on high alert for Cyclone Akvan
articles.title: Cyclone Akvan: Andhra Home Minister Anitha puts coastal districts on high alert, warns fishermen
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha ordered all coastal districts into high alert as Cyclone Akvan approaches the Bay of Bengal. During a review meeting with disaster management officials, authorities warned that the storm is projected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm before crossing the coast on Friday, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds.
articles.description: Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha asks people to stay alert over the next four days and the Agriculture Department to help farmers protect crops ready for harvest

articles.headline: Adivasi youth dies after altercation with lodge staff in Bhadrachalam
articles.title: Adivasi youth dies following assault by private lodge staff in Bhadrachalam
articles.summary: A 23-year-old Adivasi man named Tellam Sharath died following a physical assault by lodge staff during an altercation over room charges in Bhadrachalam. Local Adivasi organizations have demanded stringent action against those responsible and requested a thorough investigation into the lodge management regarding alleged violations of land regulations.

articles.headline: Revanth Reddy asks Chhattisgarh for Sammakka Sagar barrage clearance
articles.title: Revanth seeks Chhattisgarh nod for Telangana’s Sammakka Sagar barrage; Vishnu Deo assures early completion of NOC process
articles.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy met his Chhattisgarh counterpart Vishnu Deo Sai in Raipur on November 17, 2026, requesting a No Objection Certificate for the Sammakka Sagar barrage in Mulugu district. Mr. Revanth Reddy assured that Telangana will cover all land acquisition and rehabilitation expenses. Mr. Vishnu Deo responded positively, promising an early completion of the approval process to meet regional irrigation and drinking water demands.
articles.description: The Sammakka Sagar project is intended to utilise Godavari waters to meet irrigation and drinking water needs in drought-prone, backward and tribal areas of Telangana.

articles.headline: Mozambique opposition leader Venancio Mondlane stands trial over protests
articles.title: Mozambique’s opposition leader stands trial over deadly 2024 protests
articles.summary: Venancio Mondlane, opposition leader in Mozambique, appeared at the Supreme Court in Maputo on Tuesday to face five charges, including instigating terrorism related to deadly 2024 post-election protests. If convicted, he faces up to twenty-four years in prison. Mr. Mondlane denies all allegations, while rights groups report that hundreds died during a government crackdown following disputed national election results.
articles.description: Venancio Mondlane faces five charges, the most serious being instigating 'terrorism'.

articles.headline: Pakistan and Iran stress sustained coordination for regional stability in Rawalpindi
articles.title: Pakistan, Iran stress sustained engagement, coordination for regional stability
articles.summary: Pakistan Chief of Defence Forces Asim Munir met with an Iranian delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Rawalpindi on November 16, 2026, to discuss regional stability and security challenges. Mr. Araghchi also attended the Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Ministers meeting and held talks with Pakistan Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar regarding diplomatic engagement.
articles.description: Field Marshal Munir made the remarks during a meeting with a high-level Iranian delegation led by Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Rawalpindi

articles.headline: Gartner forecasts India IT spending to reach 16.9 trillion rupees
articles.title: AI, cloud investments to drive India’s IT spending to ₹16.9 trillion in 2027: Gartner
articles.summary: Information technology spending in India is projected to grow by 10.6 percent to reach 16.9 trillion rupees in 2027, according to a Gartner forecast released on Tuesday. D.D. Mishra stated that rising investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure, cloud services, and cybersecurity are driving the growth. Infrastructure as a service spending is expected to surge by 40.3 percent next year.
articles.description: India is entering a new phase of technology investment where AI infrastructure and digital sovereignty are becoming strategic priorities, says the analyst firm

articles.headline: Rebeca Grynspan emerges as frontrunner for UN leadership position
articles.title: Rebeca Grynspan could be the UN’s first woman boss, if she can sway Trump
articles.summary: Costa Rican diplomat Rebeca Grynspan is leading straw polls among United Nations Security Council members to succeed Antonio Guterres as secretary-general. Aged seventy, the current head of the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development could become the first woman and first Jewish person to hold the post. However, she faces potential vetoes and must secure support from United States President Donald Trump.
articles.description: Swaying the US could test Grynspan but she likes taking risks - and wants UN to take more, she tells Al Jazeera.

articles.headline: Ukrainian breaks world record for deepest competitive freedive
articles.title: Ukrainian breaks world record for deepest competitive freedive
articles.description: Ukrainian freediver Nataliia Zharkova has broken the world record, reaching 124 metres in constant weight.

articles.headline: Pakistan defence minister suggests country could establish new provinces
articles.title: Is Pakistan about to carve out new provinces? Inside the controversial plan
articles.summary: Defence Minister Khwaja Asif stated that Pakistan could introduce a new administrative system featuring multiple new provinces as early as the New Year. The proposal, initially raised by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi at a July summit, aims to improve governance across the country's population of approximately 250 million. Implementing the plan requires a constitutional amendment and two-thirds parliamentary majority.
articles.description: Talk of new provinces has gathered pace, but there is no formal proposal or agreement among governing parties.

articles.headline: Bangladeshi police use tear gas against garment workers protesting low wages
articles.title: Bangladesh police clash with garment workers amid protests over wages
articles.summary: Police in Bangladesh fired tear gas and stun grenades on Tuesday after garment employees blocked highways and torched vehicles during demonstrations over pay. Workers are demanding a monthly minimum of thirty thousand taka to offset rising living costs. The unrest disrupted the thirty eight billion dollar industry, prompting the deployment of Border Guard Bangladesh forces as wage negotiations continue.
articles.description: Protesters hurl bricks, torch vehicles and block the main highway between Dhaka and Mymensingh.

articles.headline: Prince William and Princess Catherine arrive in Mumbai for Earthshot Prize
articles.title: Prince and Princess of Wales in Mumbai for Earthshot Prize 2026: All you need to know
articles.summary: Britain's Prince William and Princess Catherine arrived in Mumbai on November 17, 2026, for a three-day visit hosting the sixth edition of The Earthshot Prize. Marking the royal couple's first joint overseas trip since 2024, the event brings together five thousand guests to celebrate environmental innovators competing across five distinct categories.
articles.description: The sixth Earthshot Prize, founded by Britain’s Prince William to promote innovative climate change solutions, will be presented in Mumbai on November 17, 2026
